name: ignored-star-that-crosses-a-slash-untracks-a-nested-default-path
description: cohexa-ai/agent-coherence-plugin#209: an ignored.yaml pattern without '**' is matched as fnmatch matches it, where '*' crosses '/'. docs/plans/x.md is tracked by the default 'docs/plans/**/*.md', and ignored.yaml's only entry 'docs/*.md' covers it through that '*', so it is untracked: B's pre-edit takes no grant and A's pre-edit is admitted with a bare {ok: true}. Read with the '**' grammar, where '*' stays inside one segment, the ignore entry misses the path, which stays tracked, and A's pre-edit reports a collision with B's EXCLUSIVE grant, as in fixture 22. Both backends.
